The `a2` hex decodes to `cat  | xargs bash -c` with the trailing ASCII shown in the proctitle (`bash -c cat  | xargs bash -c`). Piping process memory/cmdline contents into `bash -c` is a pattern associated with credential harvesting from process arguments and with executing dynamically assembled commands, and it runs as root with no auid set, consistent with a remotely spawned or privilege-escalated shell.
